title: Derived scalar restriction mapDerivedCategory adjunction
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and B a commutative algebra sheaf on Y whose underlying O_Y-module B.toModule is quasi-coherent [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Choose derived categories D(O_Y) and D(B), with arbitrary morphism universes w and wB [def-pc-derived-category]. Let F be scalar restriction SheafOfModules.restrictScalars along the ring-sheaf morphism induced by B.hom. Then its termwise localization F.mapDerivedCategory is left adjoint to the explicit functor derivedRHomAlgebraModule Y B hB, defined by localizing Hom(B,I(-)) with its multiplication B-action [def-pc-derived-rhom-algebra-module]. No boundedness, finiteness or Noetherianity is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0BV0 and 0BV1, together with Derived Categories Tag 09T5

proof.text: Obtain the underived adjunction sheafAlgebraHom_adjunction, with exact scalar restriction from the two exactness theorems of DerivedRHomAlgebraModule. Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction (the unbounded exact-left-adjoint specialization of Adjunction.derived) to obtain F.mapDerivedCategory left adjoint to (sheafAlgebraHom Y B).rightDerivedFunctor.

Put R = sheafAlgebraHom Y B and I = sheafAlgebraHomResolution Y. Q inverts toSheafAlgebraHomResolution since monoQuasiIso_toKInjectiveResolution_app supplies a quasi-isomorphism at every complex. The right-derived unit is invertible on I(K), since isKInjective_kInjectiveResolutionFunctor_obj supplies K-injectivity. Whisker this unit by I followed by the homotopy quotient. Compose the resolution isomorphism, quotientCompQhIso, this inverse unit and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors to construct Q followed by R.rightDerivedFunctor isomorphic to I followed by termwise R and Q_B. Compose with derivedRHomAlgebraModule_comparison inverse. Descend through Q using Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft.preimageIso, then transport the derived adjunction by ofNatIsoRight. All transformations retain the algebra-module category and hence its B-action.

theorem sheafAlgebra_mapDerivedCategory_adjunction
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (B : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (hB : B.toModule.IsQuasicoherent)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B.right))] :
    Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u}
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map B.hom)).mapDerivedCategory ⊣
          derivedRHomAlgebraModule Y B hB)
